title: (Samāpatti-abhinīhāra)
text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Cattāro me bhikkhave jhāyī || || Katame cattāro || || 4-7 Idha bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismim samāpattikusalo hoti na samādhismim abhinīhārakusalo || || [catukotikaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ] || || samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo ca || || 8-9 Tatra || pa || pavaro cāti || ||
